# Built-N-AI

> Built-N-AI is an AI automation and operations consulting company helping businesses reduce costs, eliminate manual work, integrate systems and improve productivity through practical AI, automation and process improvement. Built-N-AI helps businesses find expensive problems worth solving, build practical AI and automation solutions, and teach their teams to run them. Founded by Casey Jackson. Based in Georgia, serving clients nationwide.

Approach: start with the business problem, not the technology. Find it. Build it. Teach it.

## Services
- [What We Solve](https://builtn.ai/what-we-solve): The expensive, repetitive, measurable friction we look for: duplicate work, reporting delays, disconnected systems and repeated decisions.
- [How We Work](https://builtn.ai/how-we-work): A practical operating model built around quick wins, measurable value and capability that stays inside your company.
- [Ask Your Business](https://builtn.ai/ask-your-business): When the right systems are connected securely to AI, authorized superusers can explore ERP, inventory, sales and operational data in plain English.
- [Free Efficiency Checkup](https://builtn.ai/checkup): Ten questions, three minutes. Highlights the areas of a business most likely to contain problems worth solving.

## Case studies
- [Case Studies overview](https://builtn.ai/case-studies): Operating results from AI and automation workflows built for receiving, product data, warehouse execution and inventory accuracy.
- [AI Intake](https://builtn.ai/case-study-ai-intake): A warehouse test became a production AI intake workflow in under two weeks, reducing labor cost 81%.
- [Digital Warehouse Execution](https://builtn.ai/case-study-digital-warehouse-execution): A paper pick-ticket process became a paperless, real-time digital warehouse execution system built on Dolibarr ERP.
- [Bulk Receiving Automation](https://builtn.ai/case-study-bulk-receiving): Eliminating one-by-one barcode entry cut receiving labor cost 75% and processing time 4x on large purchase orders.
- [Attribute Backfill & Marketplace Sync](https://builtn.ai/case-study-attribute-backfill): An automated tool backfilled 300,000 part records at 98% accuracy in 9 days, then kept running for every new part.
- [Real-Time Inventory Reconciliation](https://builtn.ai/case-study-inventory-reconciliation): A barcode-driven cycle-counting workflow that identifies missing and mislocated inventory as it is scanned.
